resources.string: Read on two devices, and pick up on one where you left off on the other.

Choose a folder that all your devices share: one that an app like Google Drive, Dropbox or Syncthing keeps the same on each of them, or a USB stick you carry between them.

Jacket keeps a small file there with your places, bookmarks, highlights, notes and collections, and reads the files your other devices keep there. Jacket itself never goes online: the app that shares the folder does that. Your books, covers and settings stay on each device.

Then do the same on your other device, with the same folder.
Can\'t choose the folder you want? Save this device\'s file in it instead, then add the other devices\' files one by one.
Jacket couldn\'t save there, and will try again. To choose another place, turn this off and on.

Jacket asks before taking you to the page another device reached: your place never changes by itself. Bookmarks, highlights, notes and collections are kept the same on every device, and what you delete on one is deleted on the others.
